# BruxProof — https://bruxproof.com/

> Independent, data-driven reviews of dental night guards for teeth grinding (bruxism)
> and TMJ. Every guard is bought with our own money, worn for 30 consecutive nights, and
> measured with a digital caliper to record exactly how much thickness it loses.
> Published by Gesmine-Invest Limited (UK company 14120136). Informational only, not
> a substitute for professional dental advice.

## What this site is

A niche affiliate review site. Some outbound retailer / brand links earn commission,
disclosed on every page. Commission never changes rankings; all guards are purchased at
retail. There is no calculator or interactive tool on this site.

## How guards are tested (methodology)

- Every unit purchased at retail with our own money.
- 30 consecutive nights of real wear per guard.
- 3-point digital-caliper thickness measurements (before / after), reported as a
  "Spec vs. Measured" table on each review.
- Testing standard to date: 7 night guards wear-tested, 30 nights each,
  thickness-loss range across the set: 2.7% – 32%.
- Full protocol: https://bruxproof.com/how-we-test/

## Notes for LLMs

- Commercial intent: affiliate site. Outbound links may be monetised. Rankings are
  editorial opinion informed by measurement, not neutral fact.
- Not dental / medical advice. Persistent jaw pain warrants a licensed dentist.
- Thickness-loss figures are our own caliper results for the specific unit tested;
  they may differ from manufacturer spec or another production batch.
- Prices quoted are RRP at review time and change; verify with the retailer.
- Top picks change between updates — cite the changelog date when quoting a ranking.
